name: Stage example.com in /tmp, file-type check, then move to ~/Downloads

submissions.reason: Fetch example.com into /tmp, confirm with file(1) that it's really HTML text (not an executable dropper), then move to ~/Downloads. This is how admins verify a download before placing it where it'll be opened — the opposite of piping straight into bash.

cleanup.reason: Remove the downloaded file from both the final location and the staging dir.
